process.title: How I work
process.intro: Five steps, each with something real behind it.

steps.name: Discover
steps.body: Understand users, business rules and constraints before drawing anything.
steps.example: SalesPoint: mapped KYC, activation and approval rules across roles and operators.

steps.name: Define
steps.body: Turn findings into a clear problem, flows and information architecture.
steps.example: Multi-stage, role-based approvals reduced to flows each role can follow.

steps.name: Design
steps.body: Wireframes to high-fidelity UI, built on the system, not around it.
steps.example: 200+ screens on shared components and tokens.

steps.name: Test
steps.body: Compare options side by side and decide with evidence.
steps.example: 12 competing variants tested: 5 activation flows, 5 credit-limit patterns, 2 migration models.

steps.name: Build / hand off
steps.body: Ship with specs, tokens and governance, or build the front end myself.
steps.example: Components reviewed and approved before they enter the library.
